system.longDesc:
This armor is military-grade and designed for battlefield use, likely to show up on the streets only as a high-priced item on the black market or in urban warfare areas. Battledress comes equipped with all the benefits of assault armor (previously) along with a targeting system equivalent to a smartgun (see Weapon Accessories), artificial musculature providing a +2 bonus to Strength (Might) tests, a camouflage package that provides a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) tests, built-in sensors providing a +2 bonus to Perception tests, and mobility enhancements that provide +2 Speed and a +4 bonus to Constitution (Stamina) tests for long-term movement. Battledress is usually coupled with heavy ordinance, such as an assault rifle with a grenade launcher attachment.
